method: DB::enableQueryLog via tinker, service-level invocation per hot path with cold cache

/api/frontend/menu.cache: Cache::remember 60s (mitigates warm hits but cold boot pays full cost)

issues.label: Spatie media lazy-load N+1 on variations/extras/categories
issues.evidence: 56 distinct queries 'select * from media where model_id=? and model_type=?'
issues.root_cause: ItemVariation::getThumbAttribute and ItemExtra::thumb call getFirstMediaUrl()/getMedia() but with('variations','extras') in KioskMenuService.php:79-85 does not chain '.media'. Item itself has media loaded, but variations/extras do not.
issues.fix_proposal: Add 'variations.media', 'extras.media', 'addons.addonItem.media' to the with(...) eager-load chain. Visible-cols restriction (select narrow cols) still applies to base rel; media is a morph relation independent of the col list.

issues.label: stock_levels per-item lookup (9 queries)
issues.evidence: 9 distinct queries 'select * from stock_levels where branch_id=? and ((stockable_type=? and stockable_id=?) or ...)'
issues.root_cause: AvailabilityService / ChoiceAvailabilityResolver fetches stock levels item-by-item rather than batched whereIn(stockable_id, $ids).
issues.fix_proposal: Pre-batch stock_levels for all stockable_ids in one query, cache by (branch_id, stockable_type) inside the build() scope.

issues.label: item_branch_availability per-item lookup (9 queries)
issues.evidence: 9 queries 'select * from item_branch_availability where branch_id=? and item_id=?'
issues.root_cause: Same pattern as stock_levels — likely inside ChoiceAvailabilityResolver per-item loop. Service already does a batched availability fetch at line 92-97 for items, but a per-variation/per-extra additional fetch leaks through.
issues.fix_proposal: Consolidate availability lookups behind a single per-build memoized whereIn batch (item_ids + variation_ids + extra_ids).

slow_query_log_status.note: MySQL slow_query_log is OFF on this dev box. Cannot tail historical slow queries. Recommendation: enable with long_query_time=0.1 for V1 staging soak test.

verdict_detail: 10 of 11 probed endpoints under 10 queries / 20ms. Only /api/frontend/menu blows the budget (89 queries / 115ms cold-cache) due to Spatie media lazy-load N+1 on nested variations/extras + per-item availability/stock_levels lookups. Mitigated in production by 60s Cache::remember but still material on cold boot + every cache-invalidation event (ItemAvailabilityChanged broadcast triggers cache flush). V1 Le Cayenne LOCAL is tolerable; V2 SaaS multi-tenant requires the fix. Indexes on orders/items/audit_logs/order_items are correctly placed and cover the hot WHERE/JOIN columns.

top_priority_fixes.risk: Low. Pure additive eager-load. No behavioral change. Existing kiosk E2E specs cover the payload shape.

top_priority_fixes.change: Batch stock_levels and item_branch_availability into single whereIn per build()
top_priority_fixes.risk: Medium — requires careful audit of how the resolver computes per-choice availability flags.

note_audit_limitations: Probes run via tinker service-level — bypasses controller middleware, auth, FormRequest validation. Real HTTP request count may include +1-3 queries (session, user lookup, permission check).
Cold cache forced for /api/frontend/menu via Cache::forget. Warm cache = 0 queries (Cache::remember hit).

Dataset is small (45 items, 182 orders, 88 audit_logs). N+1 patterns surface but absolute timings will scale roughly linearly. Cloud-prep V1.0.X soak test with 1000+ items + 10k orders/day will expose hotspots not reproducible here.
